description: This file contains Lithuanian (lt) translations for the Select2 plugin, providing localized strings for the user interface.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Generates message indicating the number of symbols to remove when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Generates message indicating the number of symbols to input when input length is below minimum requirement.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Message displayed when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Message displayed when no matching results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Message displayed when searching is in progress.
